other_role.allocation_role<>a.allocation_role ) LIMIT 1 )), closing_balance=COALESCE(c.closing_balance,( SELECT o.post_fill_wallet_balance FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation a JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id=a.credential_id AND o.symbol=a.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id=a.exchange_order_id WHERE a.position_cycle_id=c.id AND c.status IN ('CLOSED','CLOSED_INCOMPLETE') AND a.allocation_role='CLOSE' AND a.exchange_trade_id=( SELECT last_close.exchange_trade_id FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation last_close WHERE last_close.position_cycle_id=c.id AND last_close.allocation_role='CLOSE' ORDER BY last_close.trade_time DESC,last_close.exchange_trade_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND o.post_fill_wallet_balance IS NOT NULL AND o.post_fill_balance_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation other_role WHERE other_role.credential_id=a.credential_id AND other_role.symbol=a.symbol AND other_role.exchange_order_id=a.exchange_order_id ON o.credential_id=a.credential_id AND o.symbol=a.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id=a.exchange_order_id WHERE a.position_cycle_id=c.id AND c.status IN ('CLOSED','CLOSED_INCOMPLETE') AND a.allocation_role='CLOSE' AND a.exchange_trade_id=( SELECT last_close.exchange_trade_id FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation last_close WHERE last_close.position_cycle_id=c.id AND last_close.allocation_role='CLOSE' ORDER BY last_close.trade_time DESC,last_close.exchange_trade_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND o.post_fill_wallet_balance IS NOT NULL AND o.post_fill_balance_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation other_role WHERE other_role.credential_id=a.credential_id AND other_role.symbol=a.symbol AND other_role.exchange_order_id=a.exchange_order_id
